target.statement: CSM achieves 0.9708 classification accuracy on CIFAR-10, compared to 0.9805 for linear probing and 0.7212 for random concept selection.

compute.basis: Requires reimplementing the two-stage CSM pipeline (greedy concept selection over 13,933 concepts and mask fine selection) from scratch, plus CLIP-ViT-L/14 inference on 50k CIFAR-10 images; no code is released.

blockers: Requires reimplementation of the full CSM pipeline from the paper description
CLIP-ViT-L/14 inference on 50k images is CPU-heavy without a GPU
title: Understanding Multimodal Deep Neural Networks: A Concept Selection View
